name: STAR Units — conversion with exact definitions and a dimension check
summary: Conversion between 64 units of ten dimensions and four temperature scales from exact definitions held as fractions; identical to SciPy within 4.5e-16 on all 416 ordered pairs and to astropy within 2.3e-16 on 328; a conversion between different dimensions (force and impulse, mass and force) is refused.
reference: NIST SP 811 and the SI Brochure: 1 lbf = 0.45359237 kg x 9.80665 m/s2 = 4.4482216152605 N exactly; 1 in = 0.0254 m; IAU 2012 B2: 1 au = 149597870700 m

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: the whole purpose: every unit has a dimension, and mixing dimensions is an error; impulse is separate from force
review.G-06: no external data: the factors are definitions written in the source as fractions
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input, for mismatched dimensions and for overflow; no iteration
